name: maviance/smobilpay-php-client
description: PHP client library for the Smobilpay partner API (v3.2.0).

suggest.guzzlehttp/guzzle: ^7.5 — Recommended PSR-18 client. Also provides PSR-17 factories.
suggest.php-http/curl-client: Lighter PSR-18 client if your project doesn't already use Guzzle. Pair with nyholm/psr7.
suggest.symfony/http-client: Use if your project is already on the Symfony stack. Pair with nyholm/psr7.
suggest.nyholm/psr7: Lightweight PSR-7/17 implementation. Pair with php-http/curl-client or symfony/http-client.
suggest.symfony/cache: Any PSR-16 implementation to persist OAuth tokens across PHP requests.
suggest.cache/apcu-adapter: PSR-16 backed by APCu — good fit for single-host PHP-FPM deployments.
suggest.monolog/monolog: PSR-3 logger if you want client wire-level logs.

scripts-descriptions.test:coverage: Run tests with coverage reporting (requires Xdebug or PCOV).
scripts-descriptions.lint:fix: Apply PSR-12 formatting fixes in place.
scripts-descriptions.check: Run lint + stan + test in sequence — the local pre-commit gate.
scripts-descriptions.smoke: Run the smoke-test harness against a real partner environment. See bin/smoke-test --help.
